_comment: Clean Up / Skillful Organizing pool (#067-072), extracted from the design project's deck-data.json. Fixture for the standalone reference only - production reads roundTwoCardsFor('clean_up') from src/lib/allyship-deck/move-library.ts.

cards.title: Name the Organizing Feeling
cards.sub: Identify channel. Which channel is active — Fire, Water, Metal, Earth, or Wood?
cards.q: Which channel is live in this coordination strain — fear, anger, overwhelm, numbness?
cards.action: Name the channel before you redesign anything.

cards.title: The 'Only I Can' Story
cards.sub: Challenge interpretation. What story am I believing?
cards.q: What story about who can do this am I treating as fact?
cards.action: Write the story that keeps you the bottleneck. Then test it: hand one thing off.

cards.title: What the System Lacks
cards.sub: Identify missing move. What capability is unavailable?
cards.q: This keeps breaking — which capability is the structure missing?
cards.action: Name the capability the structure needs — not another rule.

cards.title: Redirect the Strain
cards.sub: Select transformation. Transcend, Translate, or Neutralize?
cards.q: Do I transcend this strain, translate it, or neutralize it before I (re)build?
cards.action: Clear the charge first; then design from steadiness.

cards.title: From Control to Trust
cards.sub: Choose destination. Which channel would better serve this situation?
cards.q: Which channel would let me organize from trust instead of control?
cards.action: Re-aim one structure from trust — give real ownership, not just tasks.

cards.title: What the Breakdown Taught
cards.sub: Extract insight. What does this teach me?
cards.q: What does this organizing breakdown teach me to build differently?
cards.action: Write the one design principle this breakdown taught you.
